items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive today and traded from Cardinals to Texans (MHJ + 2027 7th for 2027 2nd + 6th).
items.why: Blockbuster trade confirmed with Schefter; inactive for ARI game.
items.implication: MHJ off ARI rosters immediately; joins HOU with Nico Collins etc. for future weeks. Cruel for owners this week.
items.opportunity: Elevates Michael Wilson immediately in ARI; long-term HOU WR room boost (Collins primary).

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play; final update after GTD status.
items.why: ETR final Sunday AM confirmation aligned with actives.
items.implication: Start McLaurin; Daniels returning boosts upside.
items.opportunity: Primary WR targets with Diggs out.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty is a go after pregame workout; plantar fasciitis/ankle flare-up resolved enough to play.
items.why: Hopeful then confirmed go; LV elevated backup RB as precaution.
items.implication: Start Jeanty as RB1; full workload expected.

items.text: Justin Jefferson active vs Saints; Jordan Addison and Odell Beckham Jr. inactive.
items.why: Pregame determination; Jefferson wanted to play homecoming in Louisiana.
items.implication: Jefferson full start; Addison out elevates Jefferson target share further.
items.opportunity: Jefferson monopoly on WR targets with Addison out.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after being listed questionable.
items.why: ETR final updates and Schefter confirmation after full Friday practices and clearing protocols.
items.implication: Start both as usual; no major usage dock expected in favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets available in CIN WR room.

items.text: Jaylen Warren should be workhorse with Rico Dowdle out; coaching staffs refuse full workhorse role despite passing every advanced/eye test (Ekeler-esque). Pre-injury was splitting.
items.why: Dowdle injury removes split; Warren advanced stats elite.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start and ROS upgrade for Warren.
items.opportunity: Increased carries, routes, third-down, goal-line with Dowdle OUT.

items.text: George Kittle officially active despite illness; expected to play vs Seahawks.
items.opportunity: Full TE usage/routes in SF offense.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot).
items.why: Active designation but limited role projected.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; avoid in DFS/lineups for volume.
items.opportunity: Elevates Tre Harris and other LAC WRs for snaps/routes.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to OUT with groin injury.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; HOU RB committee shifts.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for other HOU RBs (e.g. backups/handcuffs).

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive; chance to play next week.
items.implication: Sit Williams; CHI offense without starter QB.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers adjusted roles; Luther Burden/Rome Odunze etc. volume changes.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: NOT EXPECTED - Ladd McConkey, Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Marvin Harrison, Darius Slayton, Josh Palmer. EXPECTED - Zay Flowers, Carnell Tate, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara, Keenan Allen. GTD - Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore.
items.why: Critical early Sunday compilation of reports; messiest week.
items.implication: Guide lineup locks; many resolved later to ACTIVE/OUT.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for outs like Dowdle (Warren), MHJ (Wilson).

items.text: Zay Flowers (foot, questionable) expected to play vs Falcons SNF.
items.implication: Start Flowers; BAL WR1 with Lamar status pending.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. non-factor with only 5 catches in 4 games; was not impacting Michael Wilson usage previously.
items.why: Low production data; Wilson already elevated independently.
items.implication: Wilson further boosted by MHJ inactive/trade; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Wilson primary target share in ARI post-MHJ exit.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Performance driving adds post-games or opportunity.
items.implication: Priority waiver add in GB backfield.
items.opportunity: Potential increased role/snaps if injuries or committee shifts.

items.text: Messiest injury week remembered; still missing Bengals WR info early, many GTDs, docks on playing-through-injury guys. Projections updated.
items.why: Multiple unresolved statuses into Sunday AM.
items.implication: Aggressive monitoring required; last-minute livestream for digestion.
items.opportunity: Usage adjustments and beneficiary pivots as news breaks.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown this week (The Brown Gobbler nickname); gobbles targets and fantasy points.
items.why: Target gobbling and strong weekly outlook in CIN backfield.
items.opportunity: Routes + carries volume in favorable spot.
